howto: Set the size limit in megabytes (defaults to 10 MB).
Drop files or a whole folder onto the dropzone, or click to browse.
Every file is scanned and sorted by size — over-limit files are highlighted in red.
Check the summary stats at the top for counts and total size.
Click Download CSV report to export the full list.
features: Batch size check across hundreds of files at once
Custom size limit with clear over/under highlighting
Automatic sort by size, biggest first
CSV report export for your records

faq.q: Does this upload my files anywhere?
faq.a: No. Files are read locally with the File API and never leave your device.

faq.q: Can I check a whole folder?
faq.a: Yes — the folder picker includes every file inside, including subfolders.

faq.q: What counts as over the limit?
faq.a: Any file whose size in MB is greater than the number you set. The limit is the maximum size your destination accepts, such as an email attachment or a stock upload.

faq.q: What is in the CSV report?
faq.a: One row per file with its name, size in bytes and MB, and whether it is over the limit.
